adaptation_notes: Rejected first attempt made all structure the shell colour and reduced whole-robot contrast. That configuration and its images are preserved separately.

Current layout uses the official real-photo relationships: coloured head/body shell, neutral face/wing panels, dark neck/leg structure and neutral metallic connectors, large orange/yellow beak and entire shoe upper, yellow/purple secondary shoe edging.

Paint values are a photographic design adaptation of official Microduck colour families, not claimed official exact sRGB paint/filament numbers. Shell swatches retain official calibrated press-kit values.
Camera eye colour is expanded visibly as an annular paint area on the existing neutral faceplate, around the unchanged camera opening; no enlargement of lens or housing.
Functional black sole contact material and gripping pads stay physically and visually black.
Approval of beauty/colour blocking remains with the user; render completion is not acceptance.

This 314-part version includes the native bill backbone and axial retention candidate. The two new access head skins keep shell colours; replacement upper/lower bill skins keep orange/yellow primary accents. Geometry and physics remain unchanged by this finish configuration.

344-part update: existing palette unchanged; front-side studio fill raised from 12W to 20W to retain readable dark mechanics without raising key highlights. New grip shells accent, carriers/frame dark, pads black; no geometry edits.

419-part independent integrated candidate: new open camera face keeps neutral face colour and existing painted eye halo; actual open bezel gets scheme-specific secondary eye colour. Lens dimension proxy is dark optical material; it remains a dimensional proxy, not full vendor optical geometry. New carriers/fasteners follow deep mechanics or neutral metal. No palette or geometry edits to the default 344-part model.

446-part native head closure update: new access shells and nose shroud use main shell colour; fastened camera face uses neutral panel and existing painted halo. Four OEM-sized references stay references, with green PCB / black mechanisms / dark optical surfaces. No modifier is created; no translations or substitute geometry can hide source gaps.

Latest candidate source: mainline corrected the OEM corner stack, shroud clearance and an invisible internal carrier slope/bill-motor collision. Three previous candidates remain archived. Paint-only halo outer19.25mm/inner16.7mm, physical aperture and bezel unchanged. All colour families and camera/studio values inherited.

462-part torso mounting update: renamed torso_mounted_shell_* retain main shell colours; internal roof carriers stay dark and attachment fasteners neutral metal. Continuous446 head, palette, camera, light and coating-only halo unchanged. Approximate fore-body display normals are regenerated against the new mounted-shell hashes, not reused against changed geometry.
